K14.description:
A Seongho bolt-action rifle developed as its standard sniper rifle.

Compared to other rifles, the K14 has shorter torso killing potential, but this is made up for with its 60-degree bolt handle. Allowing for swift action of the bolt with its nimble nature. Swift aim in speed and aim walkspeed but slower when walking normally and unaiming.
K14.name: K14

INTERVENTION.description: A Grand Federation bolt-action sniper rifle famed for its precision and power. Slow fire rate, large magazine size.
INTERVENTION.name: INTERVENTION

L115A3.description: A Soveran bolt-action sniper rifle with a high fire rate chambered in the powerful .338 Lapua Magnum cartridge that can travel at really fast speed and deal a lot of damage. Even being capable of one shotting an enemy to the limb at close range! The heavy weight and slow action does however plague this weapon.
L115A3.name: L115A3

DSR-50.description:
An Eisenmark bullpup bolt-action .50 BMG rifle upscaled from the DSR-1.
Features a hydraulic recoil buffer in the stock and a blast compensator style muzzle device, a combination of sound suppression and a muzzle brake.
Offers decent fast cycling speed for an AMR with very high damage, bullet speed and heavy weight and a small magazine that holds only 3 rounds.

Model Submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
DSR-50.name: DSR-50

BALLISTA.description:
A modular Belvaunian bolt-action sniper rifle with access to multiple calibers.
Combines very high power, high bullet speed, penetration and magazine capacity for a slow fire rate, reload time and heavy weight!
Uses .338 Lapua Magnum by default but can be easily changed to another to meet your playstyle!

Model submitted by Rialag.
BALLISTA.name: BALLISTA

TIMBERWOLF.description:
A Cascadian sniper rifle in .338 Lapua Magnum with an atypical helical fluting to its barrel. Performs somewhat poorly at close range, but possesses incredibly high mid-to-long range performance.

Model submitted by Rialag
TIMBERWOLF.name: TIMBERWOLF

RAILGUN.description: The iconic electrical rifle from the moon is now in your hands! Incredibly fast bullet velocity, with an accompanying slow reload.
RAILGUN.name: RAILGUN

NTW-20.description:
A Sudenkaap anti-materiel rifle that is used against anything from equipment to against personnel. A very heavy rifle that has the power to match with its 20x82mm ammunition.
However, you must be crouching, prone or be near a valid spot, such as a window or a ledge to rest your bipod to take aim. But this can be remedied with shorter barrels.
NTW-20.name: NTW-20

MOSIN NAGANT.description: A vintage Zarovian sniper rifle dating from the 1900s. 5-round internal magazine makes for quick reloading alongside a reasonably swift fire rate. Lightweight and accurate, this rifle is meant for headshotting only but otherwise still deals large body damage!
MOSIN NAGANT.name: MOSIN NAGANT
